definition: To try to find something or someone.
exampleSentence: I need to look for my keys before we leave.

definition: To stop sleeping.
exampleSentence: I usually wake up at seven o'clock on weekdays.

definition: To get out of bed.
exampleSentence: On Sundays I like to get up late and have a big breakfast.

definition: To move into a sitting position.
exampleSentence: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable while you wait.

definition: To rise to your feet.
exampleSentence: Everyone had to stand up when the judge entered the room.

definition: To dress yourself in clothes.
exampleSentence: You should put on a warm jacket because it is cold outside.

definition: To remove clothes, or for a plane to leave the ground.
exampleSentence: Please take off your shoes before you enter the house.

definition: To lift something, or to collect someone.
exampleSentence: Can you pick up the kids from school this afternoon?

definition: To leave home for fun or a social activity.
exampleSentence: We usually go out for dinner on Friday nights.

definition: To return to a place.
exampleSentence: Please come back tomorrow when the manager is in the office.

definition: To return to a place you were before.
exampleSentence: After the holiday, we have to go back to school.

definition: To make something louder, or to arrive.
exampleSentence: Could you turn up the volume? I cannot hear the music.

definition: To make something quieter, or to refuse an offer.
exampleSentence: She decided to turn down the job offer from the bank.

definition: To delay something until later.
exampleSentence: Do not put off your homework until the last minute.

definition: To continue doing something.
exampleSentence: Please carry on with your work while I take this call.

definition: To become less angry, upset or excited.
exampleSentence: Take a deep breath and try to calm down before you answer.

definition: To end a phone call.
exampleSentence: Please do not hang up; I will connect you to the sales team.

definition: To do something more quickly.
exampleSentence: We need to hurry up or we will miss the train.

definition: To change from a child into an adult.
exampleSentence: I want to be a pilot when I grow up.

definition: To stop working, usually said of a machine or car.
exampleSentence: Old cars often break down on long journeys in the summer.

definition: To arrive, often late or unexpectedly.
exampleSentence: Only five people decided to show up for the early meeting.

definition: To move or happen more slowly.
exampleSentence: Please slow down; you are driving too fast for this road.

definition: To put something in the rubbish.
exampleSentence: Do not throw away those boxes because we can use them again.

definition: To put something back in its usual place.
exampleSentence: Please put away your toys before dinner is ready.

definition: To make a place clean and tidy.
exampleSentence: We stayed after the party to clean up the kitchen.

definition: To put on clothes to see if they fit.
exampleSentence: You can try on the jeans in the changing room over there.

definition: To become happier, or to make someone happier.
exampleSentence: Funny movies always help me cheer up when I feel sad.

definition: To exercise, or to find a solution.
exampleSentence: I try to work out at the gym three times a week.

definition: To enter a bus, train or plane.
exampleSentence: We have to get on the train before it leaves at noon.

definition: To leave a bus, train or plane.
exampleSentence: You need to get off the bus at the next stop.

definition: To continue, or to happen.
exampleSentence: The show must go on even if the singer is sick.

definition: To enter a room or building.
exampleSentence: Please come in and close the door behind you.

definition: To take care of someone or something.
exampleSentence: My aunt will look after our cat while we are on holiday.

definition: To write something on paper so you remember it.
exampleSentence: Please write down your address so I can send you the invitation.

definition: To phone someone who called you earlier.
exampleSentence: I am driving now, so I will call back in an hour.

definition: To return something to its owner.
exampleSentence: Please give back my charger when you finish using it.

definition: To meet someone by chance.
exampleSentence: I often run into my old classmates at the supermarket.

definition: To disappoint someone.
exampleSentence: I promised to help, and I do not want to let down my team.

definition: To reach the same level as others.
exampleSentence: I missed two classes, so I need to catch up this weekend.

definition: To return home, or to receive something again.
exampleSentence: What time will you get back from your trip to London?
